A: A UGC creator produces authentic, consumer-style videos for ad campaigns. This content drives up to 4x more engagement than traditional ads. Gisela creates UGC ads, testimonials, demos, and lifestyle content in both Spanish and English for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta Ads.

**Q: What types of UGC content does Gisela offer?**
A: 11 types: TikTok/Meta ads, spokesperson videos, bilingual brand ambassador content, testimonials, product demos, voiceover and on-camera (ES/EN), Reels/TikTok videos, beauty/skincare UGC, SaaS/tech UGC, fashion/lifestyle UGC, and B-Roll footage packs.

**Q: What results have Gisela's clients achieved?**
